T4.cap: Table 4. Race, class, and the speed of 311 service: request-level models
T4.note: Outcome: log(1 + hours to completion). Tract variables are standardized across the 789 analytic tracts. Models include request type × year, month-of-sample, weekday, hour-of-day, and reporting-channel fixed effects and log workload. Standard errors clustered by community area (77 clusters) in parentheses; standard errors clustered by tract (789) in brackets. Controls in column 5: owner-occupancy share, median year built, log population density, violent crimes and building violations per 1,000. *** p<0.01, ** p<0.05, * p<0.1 (community-area clustering, t with 76 df).

T5.cap: Table 5. Completion times by race-by-poverty tract group
T5.note: Coefficients on tract-group indicators relative to tracts with fewer than 10% Black residents and low poverty (bottom tercile). Tract variables are standardized across the 789 analytic tracts. Models include request type × year, month-of-sample, weekday, hour-of-day, and reporting-channel fixed effects and log workload. Standard errors clustered by community area (77 clusters) in parentheses. Within-community-area models add community-area fixed effects. *** p<0.01, ** p<0.05, * p<0.1.

T6.cap: Table 6. The “bigger jobs” test: race and class gradients by job scope and service type
T6.note: Each row is a separate model including hardship, Black share, and Hispanic share. Fixed-scope jobs restore a standardized piece of equipment (lights, signals, signs, carts); variable-scope jobs remove or clean material whose quantity varies (dumping, weeds, debris, graffiti, potholes, street and lot cleaning); see Appendix Table A2. Single-type models use month, weekday, hour, and channel fixed effects. Models include request type × year, month-of-sample, weekday, hour-of-day, and reporting-channel fixed effects and log workload. Standard errors clustered by community area (77 clusters) in parentheses. *** p<0.01, ** p<0.05, * p<0.1.

T7.note: Panel A columns (a)–(c): grades A, B, and D relative to C. Panel B column (a): HRI coefficient. Panel C columns: (a) jump in log completion time at the border, (b) with tract race and hardship controls, (c) jump in tract Black share (SD units), a balance check that is weak because tract measures cannot vary within a tract.
